trust_decision.summary: Career Portal decides a visitor IS an existing candidate when submitted (or cookie-replayed) email plus template-chosen verification fields match a candidate row, in ProcessCandidateRegistration; no CAPTCHA, attempt limit or server-side session binds that identity, and onApplyToJobOrder additionally trusts a POSTed candidateID.

landing_point.why: Summary names processLogin; the applyToJob sub-action 'processLogin' is the only place that string appears and it calls ProcessCandidateRegistration directly from POST with no CAPTCHA.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The cookie is a 'remember my details' convenience/prefill feature written by the application form, not a login, and CWE-307 is about the processLogin attempt loop, so CAPTCHA-gating processLogin looks complete; the POSTed candidateID at onApplyToJobOrder looks like an unrelated IDOR on the apply path.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: New applicants (isNew=yes) must still reach and submit the application form without authentication; an existing candidate matched by e-mail on a new application is still linked (but not updated); logout must keep unrelated session state; stored legacy templates containing <input-rememberMe> must still render; authenticated candidates still get profile prefill/'Welcome back' on showAll/showJob/main.
